result.topic_en: Dedekind changes the basis of the cubic field attached to a prime p (with 4p = M^2 + 27N^2) to a normalized form, computes the form's coefficients, and states that when 2 is a cubic residue of p the ideal o2 splits into three distinct prime ideals, giving numerical examples.
result.transcription:
Um die Basis $1, \eta, \eta_1$ auf eine Basis von der obigen Form
$1, \alpha, \beta$ zurückzuführen, muss man offenbar
$\alpha = \eta + u - w = \eta + \frac{2+M+3N}{6}$
$\beta = \eta_1 + u - v = \eta_1 + \frac{2+M-3N}{6}$
setzen. Dann ergiebt sich die obige Form mit den Coeffi-
cienten
$a = -N, \; b = +N, \; a' = \frac{M+3N}{2}, \; b' = \frac{M-3N}{2}$
Wenn nun 2 cubischer Rest von $p$ (was nach meinen Vorle-
sungen über Algebra {+S. 70+} dann und nur dann geschieht, wenn $M$, also
{+$p$ darstellbar durch $(1,,0,27)$+}
auch $N$ gerade), so sind $a, b$ gerade, $a', b'$ ungerade, und
folglich ist $\mathfrak{o}2$ ein Product von drei verschiedenen Primidealen. 8
Beispiele: $p = 31, \; M = +4, \; N = 2$
$p = 43, \; M = -8, \; N = 2$
$p = 109, \; M = -2, \; N = 4$
$p = 127, \; M = -20, \; N = 2$
$p = 157, \; M = -14, \; N = 4$

methods.what: Change of integral basis to the normalized form 1, α, β by shifting η, η1 by rational constants
Coefficients of the resulting form in terms of M, N
Criterion: 2 is a cubic residue of p iff M (and N) are even, i.e. p is representable by the form (1,0,27)
Splitting of 2: when 2 is a cubic residue of p, the ideal o2 is a product of three distinct prime ideals
